description: This file contains CUDA-specific implementations of BLAS operations such as matrix multiplication, dot product, and related utilities within the PyTorch framework. It includes function definitions, kernel launches, and helper functions for tensor operations optimized for GPU execution.

methods.name: activation_to_gemm_and_blas_arg
methods.description: Converts internal Activation enum to corresponding CUDA BLAS epilogue enum.

methods.name: isGloballyDisabledAddmmCudaLt
methods.description: Checks environment and architecture support to determine if the CUDA Lt interface for addmm should be disabled.

methods.name: isInputCompliesAddmmCudaLt
methods.description: Determines if the input tensors meet criteria to use the CUDA Lt interface for addmm, considering shape, dtype, and layout.

methods.name: launchTunableGemmAndBias
methods.description: Launches a tunable GEMM with bias and optional activation.

methods.name: launchGemmAndBiasCublasLt
methods.description: Launches GEMM with bias using cuBLAS Lt, with support for tunable operations.

methods.name: launchGemmCublas
methods.description: Launches standard GEMM operation using cuBLAS.

methods.name: addmm_out_cuda_impl
methods.description: Performs the core implementation of the addmm operation on CUDA, handling shape checks, environment conditions, and selecting appropriate GEMM paths.
